ai.title: Revert lite mode model assignments
ai.summary: Reverts lite mode to use cheaper models for agent, file requests, and new file checks. Agent lite uses gemini2_5_flash_thinking instead of sonnet. File request lite remains haiku, but normal drops to haiku; check-new-files lite uses gpt4omini. Scope includes common/src/constants.ts, backend/src/find-files/request-files-prompt.ts, and backend/src/llm-apis/gemini-with-fallbacks.ts.

eli5.text: When you use the lite mode (the cheaper, faster option), the assistant now uses less expensive AI models to get things done. Instead of the top-tier assistant model for lite agent tasks, it now uses a faster, cheaper Gemini model, and file-checking uses a smaller GPT model. This means lite mode will cost less to run, though responses might be a bit less detailed. This change is live today.

ai.title: Stripe buy-credits accepts all payment types
ai.summary: The Stripe `buy-credits` API route previously filtered payment methods by `type: 'card'`. This restriction is removed, allowing the endpoint to accept all valid payment types. The change is isolated to `web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts`.

eli5.text: When you buy credits through Stripe, the system used to only look for saved card payments and ignore everything else. Now it checks all the payment methods you've saved in your account, including cards, bank accounts, and other valid options, so you can complete the purchase with whichever payment method you prefer. You won't notice any new buttons or settings: the change only affects which of your existing payment methods are offered during checkout.

ai.title: Stripe credit purchase uses default payment method and Link
ai.summary: Credit purchase logic in `web/src/app/api/stripe/buy-credits/route.ts` now retrieves the customer's `invoice_settings.default_payment_method` instead of scanning all payment methods. Link is added to `payment_method_types` in the fallback checkout session. Card validity checks (expiry) are retained for direct charges, with Link bypassing expiry checks.

eli5.text: When you buy credits, the system now charges the default card you saved in your account (or uses Stripe Link) instead of scanning all your payment methods for a valid one. If you don't have a default payment method or direct charging fails, you'll be sent to a checkout page that accepts both cards and Link. Expired cards are still rejected for direct charges, but Link bypasses the expiry check since it's not a physical card.
